observations: OPTION MODE default (4 stars) -> byte 3; one RIGHT tap -> 4

byte stable across idle frames and unchanged into the fight scene
shipped Champion.Level1.RyuVsGuile.state carries byte 3 (default difficulty): its 'Level1' is ladder stage 1, NOT difficulty 1
